verdict.rationale: Ollama runs as a server exposing a REST API at http://localhost:11434 and installs on Linux via a shell script. Community reports describe running it on Linux for inference without the desktop app (which isn't on Linux) and using shipped ROCm containers, which implies headless server use, but no first-party doc explicitly describes headless or CI operation. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of headless/daemon serve mode, documented CI pipeline usage or official container docs, hands-on CI corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the runtime headlessly with no GUI for use in servers or CI pipelines

citations.quote: Ollama has a REST API for running and managing models.
I've been using it in Linux for inference for ages.
They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
